```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(CloneCensorWeight)
```

The multi-analysis runner reuses the same extracted data while varying the
grace period, person-time interval, or outcome model. This mirrors
CohortMethod's analysis-list pattern while preserving CCW-specific strategy
definitions.

```{r specifications}
ccwData <- createSampleCloneCensorWeightData(n = 200, seed = 42)
arms <- list(
  list(arm = "initiate", strategy = "initiate"),
  list(arm = "never", strategy = "never")
)
analyses <- list(
  createCloneCensorWeightAnalysis(
    analysisId = "cox-30-day",
    arms = arms,
    gracePeriod = 30,
    intervalLength = 30,
    modelType = "cox"
  ),
  createCloneCensorWeightAnalysis(
    analysisId = "logistic-60-day",
    arms = arms,
    gracePeriod = 60,
    intervalLength = 14,
    modelType = "logistic"
  )
)
```

Each analysis receives a dedicated output directory containing the model
results, weight diagnostics, and serialized Andromeda cache.

```{r run}
outputFolder <- tempfile("ccw-multiple-")
results <- runCloneCensorWeightAnalyses(ccwData, analyses, outputFolder)
lapply(results, function(result) result$outcomeModel$summary)
list.files(outputFolder, recursive = TRUE)
```
